{{Quote|Head up and see Lieutenant Forris when you get a chance. He'll show you how to survive in this craziness.|Sergeant Jaynes, directing a Republic sergeant to Lieutenant Forris|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Forris''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], Forris attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and was stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]] had started a conflict known as the [[Separatist War]] in an attempt to overthrow the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]]. While on Ord Mantell, Lieutenant Forris was assigned to [[Fort Garnik]], a Republic-controlled stronghold on the island of [[Avilatan]]. Forris served as one of the instructors at a [[Unidentified Fort Garnik combat instructor academy|combat instructor academy]], which was located inside the [[Fortress/Legends|fort]]. Forris and the other instructors provided combat training for the [[Republic soldier|soldiers]] stationed at the fort, including a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] named [[Jaynes]], who sent new arrivals to Forris, because he believed that the training he received had saved his life during combat.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Command's sending out new tactics all the time.|Lieutenant Forris|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Forris-TOR.png|thumb|left|200px|Lieutenant Forris in Fort Garnik]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Forris was alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, Forris served in<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Mantellian Army]].<ref name="MantellianArmy" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} As the quest involving Forris took place in the Prologue for the Trooper class, Forris can be placed in Fort Garnik during 3643 BBY.</ref> Forris had received the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and had been assigned to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]] was embroiled in<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Separatist War]]<ref name="War">{{TORcite|type=message|Date night|Doc}} identfied the war as the "Separatist War."</ref> with a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]]. By that year, Forris was a veteran [[Republic soldier|soldier]] who had learned a great deal about combat tactics and military equipment. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the planet, Forris was stationed at [[Fort Garnik]], a Republic stronghold on the island of [[Avilatan]]. There, Forris served as an instructor at a [[Unidentified Fort Garnik combat instructor academy|combat instructor academy]], where he and other instructors provided combat training and tactics to [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who were stationed at the [[Fortress/Legends|fort]]. One soldier who received training from the academy was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] named [[Jaynes]], who credited the instructors with providing training that he believed had saved his life during combat.<ref name="TOR" /> In 3643 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> Jaynes was stationed at one of the entrances to Fort Garnik, where he directed newly arrived soldiers to Lieutenant Forris for training.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
One soldier whom Jaynes had sent to Forris for training was a newly recruited [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] known as [[Havoc Squad]]. Believing that even a soldier from one of the elite squads of the Republic could learn from an experienced veteran, Forris provided the sergeant with training during the time the soldier spent at the fort.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Even Havoc Squad could learn from a veteran.|Lieutenant Forris|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Forris had fair skin,<ref name="TOR" /> [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="EyesHair" /> By the time he was serving at Fort Garnik, Forris had obtained a great deal of experience and knew enough about combat tactics, training, and technology to instruct others in their use. He attempted to pass his knowledge on to other soldiers and thought that even members of elite units could gain from what a veteran soldier like him had to say. Sergeant Jaynes believed that Forris and the other instructors at the combat instructor academy had given him the training that allowed him to survive the war on Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
While at Fort Garnik, Forris wore the blue-colored chest [[Armor/Legends|armor]], light-colored pants, and brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]] that were worn by many of the Republic soldiers serving on Ord Mantell. In addition, Forris wore a pair of black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and a blue helmet with a visor that covered his eyes but left the rest of his face exposed. While at the fort, Forris carried a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] on his back. He also carried a [[Personal energy shield/Legends|device]] that was capable of projecting a spherical [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] that could envelop his entire body.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
On [[December 20]], [[2011]],<ref name="Global Launch">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20111014-1|text=Global Launch for The Old Republic}}</ref> Lieutenant Forris appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. He is located in Fort Garnik, the central location for beginning Republic characters starting on the planet Ord Mantell. In the game, Forris is the first skill trainer for players of the Trooper class and is featured in the Trooper quest "Best of the Best," in which Sergeant Jaynes directs the characters to Forris for training. In the game, Forris has the same lines of dialogue as other Trooper trainers. While the player is not required to take the quest and can train with Forris without completing it,<ref name="TOR" /> this article is written with the assumption of 100 percent game completion. Although not identified by name, Forris's location as a Trooper trainer in Fort Garnik is shown on the maps for Ord Mantell in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a book that was released<ref name="TOREG">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref> on the same day as the game.<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Republic-Explorers-Guide/dp/0307890457|text=Star Wars The Old Republic Explorer's Guide: Prima Official Game Guide (Star Wars: Old Republic)}}</ref>
